questions.q: Who woke everyone in the block house in the morning?
choices: Doctor Livesey, calling from the edge of the wood
Captain Smollett, firing a musket from the trees
Ben Gunn, singing an old sea song from the woods nearby
The parrot, screaming about pieces of eight

questions.q: Why was Jim's gladness at hearing the doctor mixed with other feelings?
choices: He felt ashamed of sneaking away
He was afraid the doctor would shoot him
He was angry that the doctor had left him
He did not know whose voice it was
questions.evidence: I felt ashamed to look him in the face

questions.q: How did the doctor react when he learned Jim was there?
choices: He stopped outright and could not move for a few seconds
He laughed out loud and ran forward to hug Jim at once
He turned his back and walked away without a word
He drew his pistol and pointed it at Silver's head

questions.q: How did the doctor behave while treating the pirates, even though he was in danger?
choices: Calmly, as if on a visit to a quiet family
Nervously, with his hands shaking all the time
Rudely, refusing to touch any of the sick men
Angrily, shouting at each man as he worked
questions.evidence: as if he were paying an ordinary professional visit in a quiet English family

questions.q: Why did the doctor say he would not lose a single pirate patient?
choices: To keep them alive for King George and the gallows
He hoped they would pay him in gold from the treasure
He secretly wanted to join them and share the gold
He was afraid of what Silver would do if one died
questions.evidence: not to lose a man for King George (God bless him!) and the gallows

questions.q: What did the doctor say was really causing the pirates' fever?
choices: Camping in an unhealthy bog
Cutting a page out of a Bible
Drinking too much spring water
Eating spoiled pork from the ship
questions.evidence: Camp in a bog, would you?

questions.q: The doctor called the marsh "a vile, pestiferous slough." What does pestiferous mean?
choices: Full of disease
Dry and sandy
Beautiful and peaceful
Deep, dark and cold

questions.q: What did Silver ask of Jim before letting him talk to the doctor?
choices: His word of honour not to escape
The exact place where the ship lay
A promise of a share of the treasure
The two pistols in his belt
questions.evidence: your word of honour not to slip your cable

questions.q: What did the other pirates accuse Silver of after the doctor left?
choices: Playing double and making a separate peace
Stealing the treasure map for himself
Being far too cruel to the boy, Jim
Drinking up all of the remaining brandy
questions.evidence: Silver was roundly accused of playing double

questions.q: How did Silver seem when he talked to the doctor away from his men?
choices: Changed, frightened and dead in earnest
Cheerful, laughing and full of jokes
Proud, boastful and threatening
Sleepy, careless and half drunk
questions.evidence: Silver was a changed man once he was out there

questions.q: What did the doctor call it when Jim left while Captain Smollett was ill?
choices: Downright cowardly
Very brave indeed
A clever plan
A lucky accident

questions.q: What did the doctor urge Jim to do after Jim admitted he feared torture?
choices: Jump over the stockade and run for it
Tell Silver exactly where the ship was
Fight the pirates with a hidden knife
Hide in the block house until night
questions.evidence: Whip over, and we'll run for it.

questions.q: Why did Jim refuse to run away with the doctor?
choices: He had given Silver his word
He was too badly hurt to run far
He wanted the treasure for himself
He was afraid of the dark woods
questions.evidence: Silver trusted me; I passed my word, and back I go.

questions.q: Where did Jim tell the doctor the ship was?
choices: On the southern beach of North Inlet
At Captain Kidd's anchorage near the stockade
Far out at sea, drifting with the current
Sunk in deep water near Skeleton Island
questions.evidence: she lies in North Inlet, on the southern beach

questions.q: What warning did the doctor give Silver about the treasure?
choices: Look out for squalls when you find it
It is buried under the block house floor
Flint spent it all long ago in Savannah
Ben Gunn sits guarding it with a gun
questions.evidence: look out for squalls when you find it

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The doctor visits, Jim keeps his word not to escape, and Silver gets hope
Jim breaks his promise and runs off into the woods with the doctor
The pirates seize the doctor when he comes and hold him as a prisoner
Silver follows the chart, finds the treasure and sails away on the HISPANIOLA
questions.evidence: if we both get alive out of this wolf-trap, I'll do my best to save you
